{{Top|leg}}
A '''mindwarper module''' was a piece of [[DarkStryder technology]]. Trapezoidal in shape and green in [[Color/Legends|color]], the mindwarper module created a field that caused a target within a twenty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] area to fall unconscious, or become disorientated and confused, depending on their strength of will. The effect was similar to [[stun gas]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] used a mindwarper module to delay soldiers from [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] during his flight from [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].
